tema: Detrás de la app: cómo la IA ajusta tu setup al vuelo
caption:
Descubre cómo la IA de nuestra app ajusta tu setup al vuelo y gana segundos. ¿Listo para probarlo? #simracing #app #IA #setup #racing

#simracing #app #IA #setup #racing

clips.t: Nadie te cuenta cómo la app corrige tu coche al instante. Abres la app, eliges tu modelo y la pista actual.
clips.prompt: Aluminium sim racing rig with bucket seat, steering wheel, pedals, and a large monitor displaying a racing game, inside a bright home gaming room, not a real car interior. The driver holds a tablet displaying animated telemetry graphs pulsing as the setup changes, seated at the sim racing rig. Then: The driver taps the tablet screen, selecting a car silhouette and a track map icon, the rig’s monitor glows behind. smooth natural camera movement, vertical 9:16 video, photorealistic, bright natural light, sharp focus, no text, no captions, no logos, no brand names, no watermark

clips.t: La IA captura tus telemetrías, como velocidad y ángulo de giro. En milisegundos analiza la aerodinámica y la presión de neumáticos.
clips.prompt: Aluminium sim racing rig with bucket seat, steering wheel, pedals, and a large monitor displaying a racing game, inside a bright home gaming room, not a real car interior. The tablet shows a colorful speed line graph and a rotating steering‑angle dial, while the driver’s hand rests on the wheel. Then: The driver watches a 3D car model on the tablet, with blue airflow arrows and red tire‑pressure bars flashing quickly. smooth natural camera movement, vertical 9:16 video, photorealistic, bright natural light, sharp focus, no text, no captions, no logos, no brand names, no watermark

clips.t: Te sugiere bajar la carga del alerón y subir la presión ligera.
clips.prompt: Aluminium sim racing rig with bucket seat, steering wheel, pedals, and a large monitor displaying a racing game, inside a bright home gaming room, not a real car interior. The driver nods as the tablet slides the rear wing slider down and the tire pressure slider up, both highlighted in green. smooth natural camera movement, vertical 9:16 video, photorealistic, bright natural light, sharp focus, no text, no captions, no logos, no brand names, no watermark

clips.t: Aplicás los ajustes, sientes más agarre y menos resistencia. En la siguiente vuelta el tiempo mejora, notas la diferencia al instante.
clips.prompt: Aluminium sim racing rig with bucket seat, steering wheel, pedals, and a large monitor displaying a racing game, inside a bright home gaming room, not a real car interior. The driver firmly grips the steering wheel, eyes focused, while the tablet shows increased grip bars and reduced drag meters. Then: The driver raises a fist as the on‑screen lap timer drops by seconds, the monitor displaying a green improvement arrow. smooth natural camera movement, vertical 9:16 video, photorealistic, bright natural light, sharp focus, no text, no captions, no logos, no brand names, no watermark

clips.t: Repite el proceso cada pista y la IA aprende tu estilo. Sígueme para descubrir más trucos que la app guarda en silencio.
clips.prompt: Aluminium sim racing rig with bucket seat, steering wheel, pedals, and a large monitor displaying a racing game, inside a bright home gaming room, not a real car interior. The driver selects a new track on the tablet while a glowing AI brain icon expands, indicating learning progress across circuits. Then: The driver points toward the camera, smiling, with the tablet closed beside the rig, a faint app glow hinting at hidden tricks. smooth natural camera movement, vertical 9:16 video, photorealistic, bright natural light, sharp focus, no text, no captions, no logos, no brand names, no watermark
